title: Identifiability in Quantum State, Process, and Network Tomography
summary: Quantum State Tomography (QST), Quantum Process Tomography (QPT), and Quantum Network Tomography (QNT) are related parameter-estimation problems that aim to reconstruct different physical quantities. QST estimates an unknown quantum state, represented by its density matrix, from the measurement outcomes. QPT characterises an unknown quantum channel using known input states and measurements of the corresponding outputs.
